description: Coverage totals for a commit (defaults to default branch head), plus per-file totals. Codecov REST: GET /{service}/{owner_username}/repos/{repo_name}/totals/.

branch.description: Branch whose head to report on.

componentId.description: Restrict totals to a component (maps to `component_id`).

flag.description: Restrict totals to a coverage flag.

owner.description: Owner username — the organization or user login on the git service, e.g. 'codecov' (required).

path.description: Restrict totals to a file or directory path prefix.

service.description: Git service provider — one of 'github' (default), 'gitlab', 'bitbucket', 'github_enterprise', 'gitlab_enterprise' or 'bitbucket_server'.

sha.description: Commit SHA to report on (defaults to the default branch head).

name: codecov_get_coverage_totals
title: Get coverage totals
